sources.title: Testing Claude‑Opus‑4.6 Distilled Qwen3.5 9B Model Loc… | BestHub
sources.snippet: The 9B GGUF‑quantized Claude‑Opus‑4.6 distilled Qwen3.5 model runs on modest hardware (e.g., 24 GB GPU or ≥32 GB unified memory on Macs) with a 262 K context window and tool‑calling ability, but users should expect occasional slowdowns and incomplete skill handling. For more demanding workloads, the larger 27B model is recommended.
